name: dhscanner/frontphp
description: Tiny PHP HTTP front for dhscanner. Wraps nikic/PhpParser behind a single POST endpoint served by PHP's built-in dev server. Deliberately framework-less: no Laravel, no routing library, no CSRF, no sessions. The whole HTTP surface is index.php. Blade-template preprocessing (which used to live behind a second POST endpoint and pulled in illuminate/view + illuminate/filesystem) has been removed; the only PHP corpus we benchmark against contains no blade files and the dep / endpoint can be restored as a focused diff if a blade-heavy target appears.
